question: Nader drove from Mymensingh to Dhaka at 60 miles/hour. Returning over the same route , there was a lot of traffic , and he was only able to drive at 40 miles/hour . If the return trip took 1 hour longer, what is the distance between Dhaka and Mymensingh ?
explanation:
🔖Let, s=distance between Dhaka to Mymensingh.
t= time taken to travel from Mymensingh to Dhaka
V=velocity
We have s=vt
Hare s(distance) is constant
ATQ
v×t=v1×t1
60t=40(t+1)
t=20
So s=60×20=120 mile
Ans. 120 mile

question: Rahim sells 60% of apples he had and throws away 15% of the remainder . Next day he sells 50% of the remainder and throws away the rest. What percent (in total) of his apples does Rahim throw ?
explanation:
🔖Let total apple= x
At 1st day: Remaining apple=40% of x= .4x and throwing apple= .4x *15%= .06x
At 2nd day: Remaining apple=.4x-.06x= .34x and throwing apple= .34x *50%= .17x
So total throwing apple=.06x+.17x= .23 x, that menas 23% of total

question: A boy got 50% of the questions on a test correct. If he had 10 questions correct out of the first 12, and 25% of the remaining questions correct, how many questions were on the test ?
explanation:
Let, total no of questions=x


So no of correct answer= 50% of x = x/2


If 10 question is correct out of 12 then total no of remaining question = x-12 and remaining no of correct question = x/2 -10


ATQ,


25% of x-12 = x/2 - 10


Or, (x-12)/4 = (x-20)/2


Or, 4x-80 = 2x-24 


Or, x = 28
